source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    patterns = []
    patterned = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            if row[c] == 0:
                c += 1
                continue
            end = c + 1
            while end < w and row[end] != 0:
                end += 1
            if end - c > 1:
                seq = row[c:end]
                patterns.append(seq)
                patterned.update((r, x) for x in range(c, end))
            c = end
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in patterned:
                continue
            matches = [seq for seq in patterns if color in seq]
            if not matches:
                continue
            seq = matches[0]
            idx = seq.index(color)
            start = c - idx
            for i, value in enumerate(seq):
                x = start + i
                if 0 <= x < w:
                    out[r][x] = value
    return out
'''
